::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Oct 30th [1868]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS University of Edinburgh Library
:::

My dear [Christabel](people/person_329.qmd)
Thank you much for [Giftie](other_books/otherbook_500.qmd). She looks very pretty and I like her picture. Yes, we will, if we can, have a Christmas [Barnacle](organizations/other_89.qmd). I have one capitally illustrated paper for it already from [Sparrow Hawk](people/person_97.qmd).

Shall we send out the Questions for December, or January, I mean shall they go New Years day, or the month before?

I think we are to have a new [Gosling](organizations/other_104.qmd) -

[Emma Butler](people/person_822.qmd)
Wantage Vicarage
Berks.

Would you send her the rules, and the names, omitting alas [Turkscap](people/person_1520.qmd), who has grown too busy. Have you seen her pretty story, ‘[Nigel Bartram’s Ideal](other_books/otherbook_536.qmd)’ a shilling book of Warne’s

yours affectionately
C M Yonge

---

**Note:** Black-edged paper.
